title: EU calls VPNs "a loophole that needs closing" in age verification push
summary: The EU is pushing for stricter age verification measures online and has identified VPNs as a 'loophole' that allows users to bypass these restrictions, signaling potential future regulation targeting VPN services in the context of online safety policies.
problem_solved: Addresses the challenge of enforcing age verification when users can simply use VPNs to bypass location-based restrictions and content controls.
why_valuable: Highlights the ongoing tension between privacy tools and regulatory efforts to protect minors online, which could reshape the VPN industry and internet privacy landscape in Europe.
